blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, CEBU – An old bus has been transformed into an artificial reef to provide a habitat for marine life and other aquatic organisms in Olango Island. In a social media post late Sunday night, October 18, the Lapu-Lapu City District of the Bureau of Fire Protection in Central Visayas (BFP-7) shared photos of its divers participating in a coordinated effort to transport the old bus into the waters off Barangay Baring on Olango Island. The initiative involved BFP-7, under the leadership of FCSUPT Rodolfo Denaga, DSC, with assistance from the Philippine Coast Guard and the Lapu-Lapu City Environment and […]...
